title: Hospital Discharge Readiness Coordinator
tagline: A printed plan is not a safe transition until every handoff is real.

cards: Documentation makes the transition look complete.
A missing downstream receipt can make home unsafe.
The patient leaves before the service chain exists.
The clinical team sees exact blockers and owns discharge.

story.headline: The discharge plan waiting for equipment that never arrived
beats: A patient's summary and medication list are ready.
The home equipment receipt and caregiver confirmation live elsewhere.
Paperwork-only completion hides an unsafe transition.
The readiness gate names one blocker and returns the decision to clinicians.
